title: Gold-level universal design dwelling seeking the site area variation: gold level and maximum 110m2
text: C2.7.1 Accessible dwellings that seek to apply the gold level universal design site area variation as part of 4.0 – Land, C4.1.6 or C4.1.7 shall; i. be designed and constructed in accordance with the gold level universal design requirements of A4 Universal design requirements, or are certified Livable Housing Australia to a minimum gold level of performance; and ii. have a maximum internal floor area of 110m2. Note: All other provisions of the R-Codes still apply.

replaces.note: Part B applied at R30 and R40 only; draft applies to all codes via C4.1.6/C4.1.7

source.file: Residential Design Codes Chapter 2 - Single Houses.pdf

notes: Applies only where the applicant seeks the gold-level site area variation (C4.1.6 or C4.1.7); proposed fact proposal.seeks_universal_design_site_area_variation gates it. 'gold' covers either A4 gold level or Livable Housing Australia gold certification. Part C C2.7.1 (20% silver for 10+ dwellings) is not carried into this chapter.
